extraction_caveats:
1. The schedule pages (494–509) are laid out in a multi-column PDF format with up to three interval columns per page; columns were carefully reconstructed to identify repeating intervals rather than listing each individual occurrence.
2. Standard engine oil interval is 7,500 miles / 6 months; severe is 5,000 miles / 6 months — both derived from the repeating pattern across all schedule pages.
3. In-cabin microfilter standard interval is 15,000 miles / 12 months, derived from occurrences at 15,000 / 30,000 / 45,000 / 60,000 / 75,000 / 90,000 / 105,000 miles.
4. Brake fluid standard interval is 30,000 miles / 24 months; severe is 10,000 miles / 12 months, derived from repeating pattern.
5. Air cleaner filter standard interval is 30,000 miles (at 30,000 / 60,000 / 90,000 miles). No month interval is explicitly paired with air cleaner filter in the schedule.
6. CVT fluid replacement interval is 30,000 miles (mileage only, no time interval per the manual). Severe condition (car-top carrier or rough/muddy roads) also triggers 30,000-mile replacement per page 492.
7. Engine coolant first replacement is 105,000 miles / 84 months; subsequent interval is 75,000 miles / 60 months per page 508 footnote.
8. Spark plugs replaced at 105,000 miles / 84 months — only one occurrence within the 120,000-mile schedule shown.
9. Engine drive belts inspection first appears at 60,000 miles / 48 months, then at 75,000 / 60 months, 90,000 / 72 months, 105,000 / 84 months, and 120,000 / 96 months. Marked with * (recommended, not required for emission warranty).
10. Intelligent Key battery replacement pattern: 45,000 / 36 months, 67,500 / 54 months, 90,000 / 72 months, 112,500 / 90 months — every 22,500 miles / 18 months with first at 45,000 / 36 months.
11. Fuel filter: manual explicitly states periodic maintenance is not required (in-tank type); recorded with null intervals.
12. Engine valve clearance: no fixed interval given; inspect only if valve noise increases.
13. Brake fluid specification page reference (P. 10-2) was cited in the manual but the actual DOT specification was not reproduced in the provided pages.
14. CVT fluid capacity was not listed in the provided pages of the fluids/capacities table (page 512 row was cut off).
15. Drive shaft boots appear at every standard maintenance interval from 15k onward (15k, 30k, 45k, 60k, 75k, 90k, 105k, 120k), so the repeat interval is effectively 15,000 miles.
16. Brake lines and cables first appear at 15k standard, then at 30k, 45k, 60k, 75k, 90k, 105k, 120k — first at 15k, repeat every 15k (though some intervals show 30k gaps, the pattern includes every 15k occurrence).
